name: UK strikes & disruption
summary: Consultants in England strike on 25–26 Nov; RMT Tube strikes on 26 and 27 Nov, with more dates to February
state: NHS Employers reported on 26 Oct that BMA consultants in England will strike for two days on 25 and 26 Nov. RMT strikes on the London Underground are set from midday on 26 Nov to midday on 27 Nov, with further dates from 17 Dec to 25 Feb (Time Out, 9 Nov). In Northern Ireland, resident doctors plan to strike on 20–21 Nov. These are strikes in single sectors, within the Watch band; no nationwide infrastructure failure was found as of 11 Nov.
for_you: Patients in England with planned hospital care on 25–26 Nov should follow NHS guidance and attend unless told otherwise. London travellers should check TfL and National Rail before travelling on 26–27 Nov.
rubric_hit: National strike in one sector (NHS consultants): Watch; not multiple simultaneous national strikes
